semiconductor_relevance: High — Evatec specializes in thin film production solutions that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Evatec China Ltd provides advanced thin film deposition systems tailored for the semiconductor industry, focusing on applications in Advanced Packaging, Optoelectronics, and Photonics. Their innovative technologies enhance process control and flexibility, making them a key player in the production of semiconductor components.
capabilities: Batch, cluster, and inline deposition systems
Thin film solutions for fan-out wafer level packaging (FOWLP)
Thin film production solutions for Through Glass Via (TGV) applications

regional_presence.China: Evatec has a significant presence in China, focusing on providing tailored solutions for local semiconductor manufacturers.
